replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Occasionally, yes — especially when I encounter abstract concepts without clear intuition. But because I approach math with curiosity rather than pressure, the anxiety is mild and usually followed by a desire to explore it more deeply.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: Yes, I’ve used AI tools to clarify complex topics and visualize equations.
